rails.principle: Color communicates through roles and context.
rails.recommendation: Use color deliberately for identity, emphasis, surfaces, and state; keep the meaning of repeated roles consistent.
rails.context: A role-based palette is easier to maintain than unrelated local color choices.
rails.escapeCondition: Use an expressive, restrained, monochrome, or unconventional palette when it fits the project; keep essential meaning available through labels, shape, position, or other non-color cues.
